headline: Nigeria’s green economy model provides lessons for Zambia
summary: Zambia's Ministry of Information spokesperson Henry Kapata said Nigerian innovators turning waste into marketable products offer lessons for Zambia's private sector-led economy plans. The remarks followed a visit to an Abuja innovation hub.
why: Zambia is pursuing a private sector-led growth strategy, and recycling and circular-economy businesses are a growing area of investment in African markets.
